title: CRA Annex III/IV category inventory
description: The coverage list AC-03 measures against. Every category must carry an explicit coverage status and a reason; incomplete coverage blocks any definitive DEFAULT outcome.

title.description: Verbatim from B1 Annex III or IV. Never abbreviated.

technical_description.description: Verbatim from B2 Annex I or II. Elision is forbidden: shortening legal text has produced wrong conditions before. Verified sentence-by-sentence against the source.

coverage.description: State machine under DR-04: not-covered -> candidate-rule-drafted -> author-verified. A rule may be ENABLED at 'author-verified', meaning every condition is verified verbatim against the official source and the rule carries its citation into the output. candidate-rule-blocked: an open legal question prevents drafting. operative-for-exclusion: the category cannot be reliably matched but can be reliably EXCLUDED on a condition every candidate reading shares, so it does not block DEFAULT for products excluded at that gate. declared-out-of-coverage is a deliberate decision, never a default.

coverage_reason.description: Why this category sits in its current state. Required even for not-covered: a bare flag will not satisfy a reviewer.

cases.description: Catalogue case IDs exercising this category.

exclusion_gate.description: A condition shared by every candidate reading of the category, whose falsity excludes the category regardless of how the open question is resolved.

then.description: A blocked category must say what is blocking it.
Must state the gate condition that permits reliable exclusion, and the question that remains open for products reaching it.
